meta.name: Switchyard Lite
meta.essence: Refractive Liquid Glass Control Plane: 3-level optical glass hierarchy over a 4-stop mesh & fractal grain ground with WCAG AA slate ink and a Royal Cobalt turnout switch.
meta.oneSentence: Switchyard Lite dispatches coding agents across isolated git worktrees inside a 3-tier refractive Liquid Glass control plane anchored by solid slate primary actions and semantic status pills.

theme.family: constructed — Kuwayama 64×64 parallel turnout switch with 6-unit interlocking gap
theme.material: 4-Stop Mesh + Fractal Grain Ground (--app-bg) + 3-Tier Liquid Glass (--glass-1..4) + Solid Slate Primary CTA (#0F172A)
theme.edge: 1px specular top highlight (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.80)), 1px glass border (rgba(255,255,255,0.60)), concentric 16px cards inside 20px columns & sidebar
theme.stroke: zero line icons; pure filled vectors
theme.fieldRecipe: 4-stop mesh gradient + SVG fractal grain + 1px specular glass edge

primitives.name: ground
primitives.note: Mesh Sky Ground. Cool indigo-to-cloud atmospheric canvas with fractal grain.

primitives.name: plate
primitives.note: Porcelain Glass Plate. Level 1/3/4 frosted glass base & specular highlight source.

primitives.name: well
primitives.note: Mesh Well Stop. Mid-tone indigo atmospheric gradient trough and recessed controls.

primitives.name: ink
primitives.note: Obsidian Slate (Slate-900). Primary typography, headings, and solid primary CTA.

primitives.name: slate
primitives.note: Secondary Slate (Slate-600). Card snippets, control labels, and WCAG AA metadata.

primitives.name: muted
primitives.note: Muted Slate (Slate-500). Task IDs, relative timestamps, and secondary captions (4.76:1 AA on plate).

primitives.name: line
primitives.note: Crisp Hairline. 1px structural rules and table dividers.

primitives.name: accent
primitives.note: Status Progress Blue. Active turnout runs, focus rings, and links.

primitives.name: coral
primitives.note: Lock Dot Warm Coral. Signal dot in the primary turnout mark only.

primitives.name: orchid
primitives.note: Prism Accent Orchid. Decorative mesh bloom stop only.

primitives.name: success
primitives.note: Status Done Emerald. Completed status pills and online indicators.

primitives.name: mint
primitives.note: Mint Wash. Decorative status capsule fill only.

primitives.name: warning
primitives.note: Status Review Amber. Review WIP limit bottleneck and retry telemetry badges.

primitives.name: danger
primitives.note: Status Blocked/Failed Crimson. Blocked/failed indicators and destructive actions.

primitives.name: night
primitives.note: Night Control Plane Slate. Dark mode glass anchor (rgba(15,23,42,0.78)).
